record_title: Pure n-way dependence can double Student t size despite iid Gaussian proper marginals
provenance: An exact finite-sample theorem for the one-sample Student statistic under an (n-1)-wise independent standard-normal Sarmanov interaction, including a four-observation 5% size-distortion example.
limitations: The family proves exact distortion but no global extremum over all (n-1)-wise independent Gaussian-marginal laws; odd-n two-sided high-threshold corrections cancel for this sign interaction; equivalent older formulations may exist under Sarmanov, copula, exact-distribution, or robustness terminology.
